title: test_fleet_guards: default-startup mode inherits host BASH_ENV, collapsing the two test environments
description: Edge pass of 048n codereview (kimi-k3): scripts/test_fleet_guards_cycle_min.py:59-61 — _run copies os.environ wholesale and only overrides BASH_ENV in the stub case, so a host-set BASH_ENV leaks into the default-startup test and would silently collapse the two intended environments into one. Fix: pop BASH_ENV from env when bash_env is None for hermeticity.
